analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading days. Today, RSI slightly decreased from 63.3 to 62.5, remaining in the neutral zone, while the MACD histogram continues to improve, strengthening the bullish turn signal. The sideways trading has persisted for 5 days, thus maintaining the wait-and-see approach.
